prompt:
Regenerate a premium HIGH-RESOLUTION 12-pose character sprite sheet for a visual novel, preserving the specific person from IMAGE 1. IMAGE 1 is the strict FACE IDENTITY, hairstyle, outfit and build reference. IMAGE 2 supplies POSES ONLY, not its coarse resolution or mannequin appearance.
SUBJECT: 24-year-old man, slim build, short dark ash-blond hair, light stubble, slightly tired grey eyes, recognizably narrow youthful face with subtle ironic closed-mouth smile. Exact faded terracotta T-shirt, open grey-blue shirt with sleeves rolled to elbows, dark straight jeans.
MOST IMPORTANT — IDENTITY LOCK: draw exactly the SAME face in ALL TWELVE poses. Use the same head angle, same eye spacing and iris color, same nose, jawline, mouth width, eyebrows, hairstyle silhouette and hair part, age, skin tone and soft daylight throughout. ALL heads have the same almost-frontal conversational orientation and same restrained gentle expression. Treat this as one master head reused faithfully across twelve body gestures. Do not invent twelve similar people. No face beautification, age changes, smile-size drift, different curls or changing hair length. Both eyes naturally aligned and readable in every pose. Preserve identity from reference; do not turn into generic anime.
QUALITY: sharp, refined hand-painted 2D visual-novel illustration, realistic natural adult proportions, clean detailed face/eyes/hands and fabric. High-resolution smooth artwork with small carefully drawn details, NOT pixel art, NO pixelated edges, coarse dithering, mosaic or low-resolution filter. No photograph or 3D render. Render large enough to retain facial detail: target ultra-wide 6144x3584 or highest available native resolution. Do not emulate the reference's low-resolution pixels.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY 6 columns x 2 rows, 12 separate COMPLETE knee-up figures, identical scale, aligned head tops and knee baselines. Each figure has at least 8% transparent padding in its own column so elbows and open palms NEVER touch neighboring figures or canvas boundaries. Large transparent gap between rows; top margin above all hair. Crop only uniformly at knees, never hands/head. No text, labels or decorative border.
EXACT gesture order from mannequin: row1: (1) both arms relaxed down; (2) hands loosely clasped front; (3) one hand on hip; (4) arms casually folded; (5) one hand near chin; (6) relaxed weight shift, arms down. Row2: (7) one open palm raised explaining; (8) both hands behind back; (9) one hand gently holds opposite wrist in front; (10) one hand touches back of neck; (11) one forearm across abdomen, other arm down; (12) both hands open palms slightly outward. Do not change the head to perform these gestures. Exactly these twelve distinct poses, no duplicate neutral poses substituted.
Identical clothing details and body proportions across all cells. All visible hands complete with natural anatomy, five fingers; no merged fingers or extra limbs. No props or accessories.
True transparent RGBA background, no scenery, shadow plane, glow, haze, colored backdrop or checkerboard. Clean alpha edges, no neon fringe, red/blue/green stray pixels or floating fragments. This is the final game asset, not a concept collage.
intent: Smoother higher-detail illustration and consistent master head across 12 poses; original outfit and identity preserved
